text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One of its main goals is text understanding, which means a machine can read a sentence and find its meaning. NLP also makes translation possible, so tools can change text from one language into another quickly. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where a computer decides if a review or comment is positive or negative. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with people online. Thanks to NLP, technology is becoming better at communicating with us in a natural way.
